npc.note: P(taken in a day) = 1 - exp(-lambda); lambda = base x traffic x attractiveness. traffic = clamp(arrivals_day / busy_arrivals_day, min, 1): a busy hub (>= 500 arrivals a day: the Earth orbital hubs, 2 000-9 500) = 1, so a fair posting there (attractiveness 1) has lambda 0.5 / day = a half-life ln2 / 0.5 = 1.39 days (§3.7); a frontier post (2 arrivals) 0.1 -> 13.9 days. attractiveness = clamp((reward / fair - a0) / (1 - a0), 0, 2). §3.7 wrote the same idea with arrivals / 50 clamped to 3 and a fair posting at 0.5 - rescaled here so the stated 1.4-day half-life holds.
